definitions.gloss: simplified (abbreviated) character; shorthand form of a kanji
definitions.explanation: A kanji written with fewer strokes than its full form, either an informal handwritten shortcut or a simplified form that became official.

examples.japanese: {略字|りゃくじ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{書|か}く→書く：00477_kaku⟧。
「⟦{門|もん}→門：14603_mon⟧」⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{略字|りゃくじ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦メモ→メモ：00274_memo⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦よく→よく：00601_yoku⟧⟦{使|つか}われる→使う：00473_tsukau⟧。
examples.english: The abbreviated form of 門 is often used in notes.

examples.japanese: ⟦{戦後|せんご}→戦後：12853_sengo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{漢字|かんじ}→漢字：09480_kanji⟧⟦{改革|かいかく}→改革：04815_kaikaku⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧、{多|おお}く⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{略字|りゃくじ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{正式|せいしき}→正式：03376_seishiki⟧な⟦{字体|じたい}→字体：03337_jitai⟧⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧⟦{採用|さいよう}→採用：04563_saiyou⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: In the postwar kanji reform, many simplified forms were adopted as the official shapes.

notes:
⟦{略|りゃく}→略：21443_ryaku⟧ (abbreviate) + ⟦{字|じ}→字：01606_ji⟧ (character). Many standard modern kanji were once {略字|りゃくじ}: {国|こく} for {國|こく}, ⟦{学|がく}→〜学：09846_gaku⟧ for {學|がく}. Handwritten shortcuts that never became official, such as a simplified ⟦{門|もん}→門：14603_mon⟧, are still called {略字|りゃくじ}, and should not be used in formal writing.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {略字|りゃくじ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{使|つか}う→使う：00473_tsukau⟧: to use an abbreviated form
- {略字|りゃくじ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{書|か}く→書く：00477_kaku⟧: to write in shorthand characters

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{旧字体|きゅうじたい}→旧字体：27161_kyuujitai⟧: the old, full form of a kanji ({國|こく}, {學|がく})
- ⟦{簡体字|かんたいじ}→簡体字：13894_kantaiji⟧: the simplified characters of mainland Chinese
- ⟦{略語|りゃくご}→略語：21705_ryakugo⟧: an abbreviated word, not a character
